Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Trade Marketeer role at Van de Velde. Your focus on premium lingerie and on igniting the power in women resonates with me, and I would bring a digital-first, commercially minded approach to activating your brands with wholesale partners.

In my current role at Episto, I build and optimise client websites, run SEO and content campaigns, and report on performance with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. Previously, at Knowledge Experts, I supported digital workplace projects for large retail and logistics organisations, including ŞOK Market, and built WordPress sites from structure to content. I also created mirook.com, where I implemented structured data, knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative technical audits that measurably improved search health. I am fluent in English and comfortable using data to shape marketing decisions.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my mix of marketing, web and analytical skills can support your wholesale activation plans.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

Van de Velde's mission to ignite the power in women, and its century of craft behind brands like Marie Jo, Primadonna and Sarda, is exactly the kind of environment where I want to grow as a marketer. I am applying for the Trade Marketeer role because it sits at the intersection I know well: translating brand strategy into concrete activations that drive sell-out, both online and offline.

My background is digital marketing with a technical edge. At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and content for client websites, and I track results with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. Before that, at Knowledge Experts, I supported the team on SharePoint-based digital workplace projects for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, and built WordPress sites for clients from site structure to content and social media integration. I also built and optimised mirook.com, where I implemented JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative technical audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. That project taught me how to combine brand consistency with performance data, and how to keep improving a framework based on what the market actually responds to.

I am fluent in English, with Turkish as my native language and Dutch at B1 writing level. I enjoy working across teams, gathering insights from partners and field interactions, and turning them into clear recommendations. I am drawn to Van de Velde's values of passion, quality and authenticity, and I would bring curiosity, structure and a genuine interest in fashion to your wholesale activation plans.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can contribute to your team.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
